title: I built OpenClaw for Stocks
author: xjx546
selftext:
Hello AI Traders,

I'm the solo dev/founder of FN2 and it's completely free (At least for one or two agents and some amount of chat usage) with no strings attached if you don't intend to buy a subscription. 

You can use FN2 to monitor Price Movements, Economic Conditions, etc, and unlike similar tools like Claude and ChatGPT they can run in the background, similar to tools like Hermes and OpenClaw. Initially it was built for my own at home but I kept polishing it and decided to open it up to friends and other people interested in a research desk-style tool.

Feedback is welcome!

comments.author: do0fusz
comments.body: A github link would have been nice

comments.author: Scott_Malkinsons
comments.body:
\*sigh\* yet another person building before they understand how LLM's work.

Do yourself a favor. open up Claude or whatever you use. Now give it a chart, csv tick data, ask it to find the data itself, whatever and ask for a trade or advice. After you get the advice, start a new chat and then give it the same data and prompt.

Notice how the answer is different? Often times vastly different, like it was saying go long but now it's saying go short. Well congrats, you just learned why this won't work, doesn't work, and how LLM's aren't actually intelligent.

replies.author: xjx546
replies.body:
What you are saying is correct, but at the end of the day our AI is just a research tool. 

For example, I'm using it to research energy stocks. After a few months of data I had enough information to swing trade on own one or two tickers. It's primarily there for things like that, to help you make your own investing decisions, get notified if something changes, or plug into your own automation and algo trading workflow (i.e. our [OpenClaw Plugin](https://github.com/fn2ai/fn2-openclaw-skill/blob/main/README.md)).

comments.author: SnowSilent7695
comments.body:
Very cool! And thanks for sharing the repo. Are you doing any kind of data management on your side?

I built something similar, aggregating data from various sources for agents to chart live data, provide real-time updates and full-blown reports on equities. And man, data management and QC is a full-time job.

I created a MCP and sharing demo in Claude. If curious, here's how you'd connect (gives Claude read-only access to my API that I actively maintain):   
  
Customize > Add custom connection > in remote server url paste [https://mcp.flexreportfinapi.com/mcp](https://mcp.flexreportfinapi.com/mcp)

Sharing the repo as well: [https://github.com/cbecks1212/flexreport-mcp](https://github.com/cbecks1212/flexreport-mcp)
